reason: A DSH profile and plugin bundle that presents curated DSH documentation in a searchable, translatable web reader with table-of-contents navigation and an adjacent conversation panel.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 文档整理为支持搜索、翻译、目录导航和对话面板的本地网页阅读界面。
summaries.en: A local web reading interface that organizes DSH documentation with search, translation, table-of-contents navigation, and an adjacent conversation panel.

capabilities: Provides a local web-based document reading interface
Organizes and searches a curated documentation corpus
Displays a sliding table of contents and conversation panel
Installs and configures a DSH profile and plugin bundle
